entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Just need the return authorization.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, could I please have your name and the email address you used for the purchase?
It's under Alex Chen. a.chen@email.com. Look, I'm a bit short on time, so can we just get to whether this is a yes or a no?

Of course, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the order for the Trail Helmet placed last month. To make sure I process this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color isn't right. The box is unopened. It's brand new.
Understood. One moment while I review the return eligibility for you.
Is it within the window or not?
Yes, it is. I see you received the helmet 29 days ago, and our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. So you're all set.
Great. So you're sending the label?

Absolutely. While the color wasn't a perfect match, your safety on the trail is what's most important, and we want you to be completely satisfied with your gear. Since the box is unopened, the return will be very simple. I've just approved it and sent a prepaid return label to your email. You should receive it momentarily.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
